scientific_integrity: The order-two constants are proved through the stationary environment resolvent, a Poisson corrector and an exact Fourier integral. The finite ring tests are diagnostic, not proofs of infinite-lattice claims. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed positive refresh rate, the result holds at sufficiently small disorder only. It does not provide uniform control as refresh tends to zero, arbitrary-disorder signs, or higher-dimensional analogues. The prior 2016 perturbative theory supplies the analytic method and may enable other derivations. Independent priority review remains necessary.
title: Universal weak-disorder Einstein deficit for refreshed conductances
